description: This file defines the 'Geometry' class, an internal utility for handling geometric data within Apache Spark's SQL Catalyst module. It includes methods for creating, copying, and converting geometries, as well as parsing WKB, EWKB, WKT, and EWKT formats, although some parsing methods are not yet supported.

classes.name: Geometry
classes.description: A utility class representing geometric data, providing methods for creation, copying, and format conversions, as well as SRID management.

methods.name: fromBytes
methods.description: Creates a Geometry instance from a byte array.

methods.name: fromValue
methods.description: Creates a Geometry instance from a GeometryVal object.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Returns the byte array representation of the geometry.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Geometry object.

methods.name: fromWkb
methods.description: Creates a Geometry object from WKB byte array with specified SRID.

methods.name: fromWkt
methods.description: Parses WKT format with specified SRID (not yet supported).

methods.name: toWkb
methods.description: Converts the geometry to WKB format.

methods.name: toWkb
methods.description: Converts the geometry to WKB format with specified endianness.

methods.name: toEwkb
methods.description: Converts the geometry to EWKB format (not yet supported).

methods.name: toEwkb
methods.description: Converts the geometry to EWKB format with specified endianness (not yet supported).

methods.name: toWkt
methods.description: Converts the geometry to WKT format (not yet supported).

methods.name: toEwkt
methods.description: Converts the geometry to EWKT format (not yet supported).

methods.name: srid
methods.description: Returns the SRID of the geometry.

methods.name: setSrid
methods.description: Sets the SRID of the geometry.
